acceptance: Role, name, labels and relations are computed per element and survive RTL, nesting and disabled controls; labels are indexed per root so naming stays linear; geometry is read only for probed nodes and carries an epoch and sequence stamp.

positive.fixture: 6 browser tests: Arabic and bidi marks kept byte for byte, fieldset-disabled propagation, labelledby and describedby relations, zero layout reads during capture

negative.fixture: 16000 buttons with ids capture without per-control document scans; labels that appear, move or vanish rename their controls; values are never read

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Cold capture of 50009 nodes fell from 12.7 s to 505 ms after the label index replaced per-control label scans.
known_limitations: Names use a simplified accname algorithm, not the browser accessibility tree
